data.name: Gulshanun
data.gender_notes: Gulshanun is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A beautiful and enchanting garden filled with roses. The name Gulshanun carries the meaning “Garden of roses” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Gulshanun usually hope their child will grow to embody garden of roses and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Gulshanun belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Garden of roses.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Gulshanun total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_arabic.name: غولشانون
in_arabic.meaning: الورد الجميل ، الزهرة الجميلة في الجنة
in_arabic.long_meaning: غولشانون هو اسم مشتق من الكلمة العربية 'غولش' والتي تعني الورد أو الزهرة الجميلة. يوحي الاسم بالجمال والروعة، وقد ورد في بعض التفسيرات أنه يعني الزهرة الجميلة في الجنة. يستخدم الاسم في بعض الثقافات الإسلامية للإشارة إلى الجمال الروحي والفطرة السليمة.

in_urdu.name: گلشنون
in_urdu.meaning: خوبصورت گل، جنت کا کھلا ہوا پھول
in_urdu.long_meaning: گلشنون ایک عربی मूल کا نام ہے جس کا مطلب ہے خوبصورت گل یا جنت کا کھلا ہوا پھول۔ یہ نام جمال اور خوبی کی علامت ہے، اور بعض اوقات روحانی جمال اور فطرت کی سادگی کی بھی نشاندہی کرتا ہے۔ جنوبی ایشیاء میں مسلمانوں کے ذریعہ اس نام کا استعمال جمال اور تقوی کی ترکیب کے طور پر کیا جاتا ہے.

in_hindi.name: गुलशनून
in_hindi.meaning: सुंदर फूल, स्वर्ग का खिलता हुआ फूल
in_hindi.long_meaning: गुलशनून एक अरबी नाम है जिसका अर्थ है सुंदर फूल या स्वर्ग का खिलता हुआ फूल। यह नाम सौंदर्य और पवित्रता का प्रतीक है, और अक्सर आध्यात्मिक सुंदरता और सादगी की ओर संकेत करता है। भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में, यह नाम अच्छे चरित्र और धार्मिकता के संयोजन के रूप में प्रयोग किया जाता है।

in_pashto.name: ګلشنون
in_pashto.long_meaning: ګلشنون د عربي اصل يو نوم دی چې د ښکلی ګل يا د جنت ګل معنی لري. دا نوم د ښکلا او پيورۍ نښه ده، او کله ناکله د روحاني ښکلا او سادګۍ نښه هم کوي. په افغانستان او پښتونستان کې، دا نوم د ښکلي چلچتر او دينيات ترکیب په توګه کارول کيږي.

in_english.name: Gulshanun
in_english.meaning: Beautiful rose, lovely flower in paradise
in_english.long_meaning: Gulshanun is a name derived from Arabic, meaning a beautiful rose or a lovely flower in paradise. The name symbolizes beauty, elegance, and purity. Etymologically, it is linked to the Arabic word 'gulshan,' which means a garden or a place of beauty. In Islamic tradition, such names are often used to signify spiritual beauty and a connection to the divine. The name Gulshanun reflects a combination of aesthetic appeal and spiritual significance.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Gulshanun" evokes images of a lush, vibrant, and stunning garden. This name holds a significant cultural impact in the Islamic world, as gardens and the beauty of nature are often used as metaphors for Paradise in Islamic literature and tradition. The name has been used in various poetry, literature, and even as the name for a beautiful mosque complex in the heart of Istanbul.
data.spiritual_significance: The name "Gulshanun" holds a deep spiritual significance in Islam as it symbolizes the Garden of Paradise. In Islamic teachings, the Garden of Paradise is a place of immense beauty and blessings, filled with rivers, gardens, and various delights that please the senses. The name "Gulshanun" serves as a reminder of the ultimate goal in life - to strive towards attaining Paradise and the endless blessings it offers. It encourages individuals to pursue goodness, righteousness, and piety, in the hope of securing a place in the beautiful garden of Paradise.
